purpose: Declared controller deviations from the RTD unit that bind_controller_rtd.py --deviations lets past its census / MPN / pad-net ABORT gates. The native export goes to Rust unchanged, so the Rust validator still sees and judges every one of them (WAIVERS.md W6, W7). A declaration the board no longer matches aborts the binder, so stale declarations are not accepted silently.
